quests.title: A Thread of Dawn-Light

dialogue.t: I appreciate the help. Let's meet back here once you find that power core.
Hey, if it isn't Alyosha!
{NICKNAME}, Paimon? It's been a while. How are you feeling, Paimon?
Don't worry, Paimon's all better now! What are you doing out here?
I want to fix up this abandoned station.
Hey, if it isn't Alyosha!
{NICKNAME}, Paimon? It's been a while. How are you feeling, Paimon?
Don't worry, Paimon's all better now! What are you doing out here?
I want to fix up this abandoned station.
You too?
Ah. Guessing you've already been here with Odette or Vodyanitsa.
The idea started out as something Vodyanitsa randomly brought up at a party. Before I knew it, I'd been roped in to help.
If we can restore this station so it's back up and running again, everyone who lives around here will benefit greatly.
Unfortunately, our government's too busy executing some grander plan to notice this little spot. So it's up to citizens like me to step up.
But that's fine by me. It's one way I can stand up for what the Rokot believes in without having to reach for my gun.

dialogue.sit: Paimon and I will help too.

dialogue.t: Yeah! The two of us have done this sort of thing plenty of times!
Alright, but I can't let you help us for nothing. I'll make sure you're paid fairly.

dialogue.sit: Where do you want to start?

dialogue.t: I'd like to fix this station's heat source first, but...
I had the technicians from the Rokot check it out. They said this kind of furnace needs a certain power core. Without that, it won't start.
A power core? Where are we supposed to find one of those?
No idea yet. All I know is, it's something to do with the Shadow Realm tech excavated during the Belyi Tsar's time.
Good point. We did run into quite a few gang members back when we discovered those underground ruins.
I remember them saying that the gangs are secretly excavating various Shadow Realm relics. They could well have what we're looking for.
I heard from a friend at the Rokot that there's a gang active near here.
But if we start investigating just on a hunch, who knows when we'll find what we need? Things have been pretty busy at the Rokot lately, too...
Looks like we'll have to put the repair work at this station on hold for now. We'll come back to it when we have the chance.
Don't worry, Alyosha. You handle things with the Rokot first. We'll investigate those gang members.
...Guess I'll need to raise your pay.
I appreciate the help. Let's meet back here once you find that power core.
Actually, we've already looked into all that gangland stuff.
Oh, right! And we got that strange crystal thing, didn't we? Do you think it's the power core for the furnace?
What a coincidence. Can I take a look?
Can I take a look at that crystal you obtained?
Alyosha, good to see you again!
We got this interesting-looking crystal from the fae gang. Take a look! Is this what we're looking for?
Great work, you guys. Gimme a second to inspect it.
Great work, you guys. Gimme a second to inspect it.
Ooh, there we go, it's fixed! This heater is amazing. Paimon feels nice and warm already!
Thanks to you two, this step of the renovations is finally complete. Please accept this in return.
Hehe... So, is there anything else you need help with?
I said I was gonna pick out a few cute puppies to act as guard dogs here... but I can handle that. No need to bother you with it.
Once all the repair work is complete, this station should make a great little gathering spot.
So be sure to drop by if you have the time.
We sure will!

quests.description: You bump into Alyosha near a station. He wants to do something for this particular station…
